prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.2 °C (68% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.4 °C (50% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.8 °C (58% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.95 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 0.01 s (100% below healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.35 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 379 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.1 % (4% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.0 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.
